## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

[Roche publishes its first quarter results for 2026][103]

Roche reports 7% (CER) sales for the full year results in 2025. Commenting on the results, CEO
Thomas Schinecker said: “2025 was a strong year for Roche, reflecting our continued focus on
operational and R&D excellence.”

[How we improved outcomes for patients around the world][104]

With our combined strengths in Diagnostic and Pharmaceuticals, we worked to provide real and
positive change for patients, the people they love and the professionals who care for them. Discover
the highlights in our Annual Report.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Carista?

Carista is a mobile App used with a Carista OBD2 Scanner that empowers drivers to diagnose dashboard
warning lights, customize vehicle settings, perform essential car service, and monitor live data. It
provides brand-specific, dealer-level features for supported vehicles in a simple, user-friendly
package.

Can you use Carista for free?

Yes. Carista gives you free access to essential features, including reading and clearing standard
OBD2 fault codes, live OBD2 data, emissions tests readiness to see whether your car is likely to
pass an emissions inspection, detailed ECU information, and tools like the acceleration test. You
can use these features by simply connecting your car to an OBD2 adapter. Advanced diagnostics,
manufacturer-specific codes, and vehicle customizations require a paid subscription (monthly or
yearly).

Can you clear codes with Carista?

Yes, you can clear fault codes with Carista.

You scan your vehicle’s systems like Engine, ABS, SRS/Airbag, Transmission, TPMS, and other
electronic units directly from the App. After reviewing the diagnostic results, you can clear the
codes and reset warning lights. This allows you to verify repairs and monitor whether a fault
returns.

What cars does Carista work on?

Carista works with a wide range of car brands and supports many models within each one. The features
you can use depend on your vehicle’s make, model, and year.

Supported brands include: Audi, BMW, Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Cupra, Dacia, Ford, Genesis, GMC,
Holden, Hyundai, Infiniti, Jaguar, Kia, Land Rover, Lexus, Lincoln, MAN, Mazda, MINI, Nissan,
Opel/Vauxhall, Pontiac, Renault, Saab, Scion, SEAT, Škoda, Toyota, Volkswagen, and Volvo.

How does Carista work?

Simply plug the Carista OBD2 Scanner into your vehicle’s OBD2 port, connect to the Carista App via
Bluetooth, and access diagnostics, live data, service tools, and customizations. Advanced features
require a subscription.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Carista?

Carista is a mobile App used with a Carista OBD2 Scanner that empowers drivers to diagnose dashboard
warning lights, customize vehicle settings, perform essential car service, and monitor live data. It
provides brand-specific, dealer-level features for supported vehicles in a simple, user-friendly
package.

Can you use Carista for free?

Yes. Carista gives you free access to essential features, including reading and clearing standard
OBD2 fault codes, live OBD2 data, emissions tests readiness to see whether your car is likely to
pass an emissions inspection, detailed ECU information, and tools like the acceleration test. You
can use these features by simply connecting your car to an OBD2 adapter. Advanced diagnostics,
manufacturer-specific codes, and vehicle customizations require a paid subscription (monthly or
yearly).

Can you clear codes with Carista?

Yes, you can clear fault codes with Carista.

You scan your vehicle’s systems like Engine, ABS, SRS/Airbag, Transmission, TPMS, and other
electronic units directly from the App. After reviewing the diagnostic results, you can clear the
codes and reset warning lights. This allows you to verify repairs and monitor whether a fault
returns.

What cars does Carista work on?

Carista works with a wide range of car brands and supports many models within each one. The features
you can use depend on your vehicle’s make, model, and year.

Supported brands include: Audi, BMW, Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Cupra, Dacia, Ford, Genesis, GMC,
Holden, Hyundai, Infiniti, Jaguar, Kia, Land Rover, Lexus, Lincoln, MAN, Mazda, MINI, Nissan,
Opel/Vauxhall, Pontiac, Renault, Saab, Scion, SEAT, Škoda, Toyota, Volkswagen, and Volvo.

How does Carista work?

Simply plug the Carista OBD2 Scanner into your vehicle’s OBD2 port, connect to the Carista App via
Bluetooth, and access diagnostics, live data, service tools, and customizations. Advanced features
require a subscription.

# Israeli tech, mapped for serious investors.

Claw & Talon helps independent investors, angels, family offices, and strategic capital allocators
understand Israeli startups, dual-use technology, funds, public-market exposure, and resilience
themes before making decisions.

Use the site for research, education, database exploration, sector context, diligence preparation,
and advisory inquiry scoping. It is not investment advice or a securities offering.

[Start learning][9] [Browse the Startup Database][10]
[Claw & Talon logo]

## One research workflow: learn, screen, analyze.

Everything on the site supports the same sequence. Build the frame in Learn, use the database to
compare real companies, then use the research tools to test whether a theme survives sharper
questions. Each surface links to the next step, so a broad interest in Israeli technology becomes a
bounded research task with a clear evidence standard.

[ Learn

### Learn the market

The knowledge base moves in order from Startup Nation basics to exposure routes, sector themes,
diligence checklists, and risk vocabulary. Start here if Israeli technology, private markets, or the
site vocabulary is new.

][11] [ Screen

### Screen companies in the database

The Startup Database is a research surface with entity types, editorial relevance signals, sector
pages, and verification prompts. Compare companies within a sector before comparing scores across
sectors.

][12] [ Analyze

### Build and test a thesis

The Dependency Atlas and the research apps translate resilience bottlenecks into sectors, company
types, buyers, evidence standards, and risks you can pressure-test before committing attention.

][13]

## Start where you are.

Different investor types need different evidence. An angel preparing a founder call, a family office
weighing manager selection, and a public-market reader studying a technology theme are making
different decisions with different risks. Pick the entry point that matches your role, then move
into the database and checklists with the right questions in mind.

[ Start

### New to Israeli tech

Learn the ecosystem, vocabulary, exposure routes, and common investor mistakes before opening
company profiles.

][14] [ Direct

### Angel or direct investor

Use profiles, sector pages, and checklists to prepare founder calls, evidence requests, and
syndicate or SPV reviews.

][15] [ Portfolio

### Family office or fund evaluator

Compare direct, fund, public-market, strategic, and research-only exposure routes before allocating
attention or capital.

][16] [ Strategic

### Dual-use or public-market investor

Translate cyber, AI, defense, and resilience themes into evidence-based questions without confusing
mature public exposure with private startup access.

][17]

## Use the database like an investor.

The Startup Database is a research surface, not a recommendation engine. Scores are editorial
research signals for comparison and prioritization. They are not investment ratings,
recommendations, suitability assessments, allocation availability signals, or return predictions.

Start with a sector, compare entity type before comparing scores, then open the relevant diligence
checklist before contacting a founder, lead, manager, or public-company source.

[ Startup Database Browse companies and ecosystem entries ][18] [ Investor database guide Interpret
scores and entity types ][19] [ Diligence Checklists Prepare questions before outreach ][20]
[Abstract Israeli startup database interface with entity badges, verification icons, score signals,
and diligence checklist panels.]

## Scoped research support when self-serve is not enough.

Contact Claw & Talon when a decision needs more context than a public profile can provide: a company
screen, a sector landscape, a diligence memo, founder-call preparation, an Israeli ecosystem
orientation, or a database licensing conversation. Scoped research support sharpens questions,
pressure-tests claims, and organizes evidence. It does not provide investment recommendations or
deal placement.

[Contact Claw & Talon][21] [Database licensing][22]

## What Claw & Talon is, and is not.

The distinction matters because Israeli technology attracts strategic language, and strategic
language can blur the line between research and recommendation. Every page on this site is written
to keep that line visible: learning about a company, having access to a round, and making a suitable
investment are three separate questions, and only the first one is answered here.

### What Claw & Talon is
* Independent research and education.
* Public-source company and sector intelligence.
* Strategic context for Israeli technology.
* Diligence frameworks and scoped research support.

### What Claw & Talon is not
* Not investment advice.
* Not legal or tax advice.
* Not a broker-dealer.

to setup.

## How ClickReflex Measures Human Performance

A standardized performance framework designed to measure reaction speed, response consistency, and
cognitive stability under real-world conditions.

### Reaction Speed Benchmark

Measure how quickly you respond to visual stimuli in milliseconds. This creates a clean, repeatable
baseline for comparing responsiveness across sessions, devices, and conditions.

### Response Speed vs Execution Accuracy

See how raw reaction speed translates into controlled and accurate execution. Fast reactions do not
always lead to stable performance.

### Consistency Under Cognitive Interference

Test how stable your responses remain when attention, visual noise, or unpredictability increase.
This highlights performance consistency — not just peak speed.

### AI Performance Analysis

Receive a structured explanation of your reaction patterns, response stability, and potential
bottlenecks in plain language. No medical diagnosis. No exaggerated performance claims.

## Two Ways to Use ClickReflex

Start with standardized benchmarks — or explore game-style reflex challenges anytime.

### Standardized Tests for Measurement & Comparison

Benchmark mode uses fixed conditions to ensure accurate measurement and percentile ranking. Results
are used for analysis and comparison only.

### Fast, Repeatable Reflex Challenges

Game-style tests are designed for exploration and replay. They are quick, engaging, and do not
affect benchmark analysis. Play anytime. No evaluation required.

Yes. All core tests and play modes are free and require no signup.

### Products
### 

[Multicolumn Image]

Equip your laboratory for peak performance with Copan's unmatched, expertly engineered sample
collection and transport devices and laboratory essentials.

[ Explore Products ][62]

### Laboratory Automation & AI

[Multicolumn Image]

Unlock new levels of efficiency with Copan's transformative automation and AI innovations.
Experience how our customized solutions support your team so you can focus on what matters most.

[ Learn More ][63]

### Scientific Studies
### 

[a]

Explore our full library of scientific studies documenting the proven performance of our innovative
collection devices, automation, and AI across diverse applications and workflows.

[ Find Studies ][64]

## Innovation is in Our DNA

Since 1979, Copan has combined innovation with a forward-looking vision for the laboratory,
developing early automation concepts and inventing flocked swab technology, now a global standard in
specimen collection.

 

Today, we continue to innovate with solutions that strengthen every step of the laboratory workflow,
from specimen collection and transport to processing and interpretation, integrating automation and
AI to improve efficiency and consistency.

 

Working in close collaboration with the microbiology community, we solve real laboratory challenges
so laboratories can deliver reliable results and support better patient care.

## FDA-Cleared Innovation

PhenoMATRIX^{®}, Copan’s AI-powered image assessment software for WASPLab^{®} automation, is now FDA
510(k) cleared in the United States.
By automatically sorting culture plate images using artificial intelligence and laboratory-defined
rules, PhenoMATRIX helps laboratories streamline plate review, improve efficiency, and maintain
expert control.

### Products

[Multicolumn Image]

Equip your laboratory for peak performance with Copan's unmatched, expertly engineered sample
collection and transport devices and laboratory essentials.

[ Explore Products ][62]

### Laboratory Automation & AI

[Multicolumn Image]

Unlock new levels of efficiency with Copan's transformative automation and AI innovations.
Experience how our customized solutions support your team so you can focus on what matters most.

[ Learn More ][63]

### Scientific Studies
### 

[a]

Explore our full library of scientific studies documenting the proven performance of our innovative
collection devices, automation, and AI across diverse applications and workflows.

[ Find Studies ][64]

## Innovation is in Our DNA

Since 1979, Copan has combined innovation with a forward-looking vision for the laboratory,
developing early automation concepts and inventing flocked swab technology, now a global standard in
specimen collection.

 

Today, we continue to innovate with solutions that strengthen every step of the laboratory workflow,
from specimen collection and transport to processing and interpretation, integrating automation and
AI to improve efficiency and consistency.

 

Working in close collaboration with the microbiology community, we solve real laboratory challenges
so laboratories can deliver reliable results and support better patient care.

## FDA-Cleared Innovation

PhenoMATRIX^{®}, Copan’s AI-powered image assessment software for WASPLab^{®} automation, is now FDA
510(k) cleared in the United States.
By automatically sorting culture plate images using artificial intelligence and laboratory-defined
rules, PhenoMATRIX helps laboratories streamline plate review, improve efficiency, and maintain
expert control.

[ Read More ][65]

**ERIS PARFUMS** was launched in 2016 by vintage perfume lover **Barbara Herman.** Her years of
collecting and researching vintage perfume took her on a journey that started with her
blog, [**Yesterday’s Perfume**][81], which turned into a book, [***Scent and Subversion: Decoding a
Century of Provocative Perfume***][82] (Lyons Press: 2013)

After interviewing Master Perfumer [**Antoine Lie**][83] for *Scent and Subversion*, Barbara asked
him to help her create a collection of fragrances as bold as her favorite vintage perfumes but for a
modern audience.

Named after ERIS, the Greek goddess of troublemaking and disruption, ERIS PARFUMS is inspired by
muses — divine, human, and fragrant — that exemplify unconventional beauty and subversive glamour.

**ERIS PARFUMS** was launched in 2016 by vintage perfume lover **Barbara Herman.** Her years of
collecting and researching vintage perfume took her on a journey that started with her
blog, [**Yesterday’s Perfume**][81], which turned into a book, [***Scent and Subversion: Decoding a
Century of Provocative Perfume***][82] (Lyons Press: 2013)

After interviewing Master Perfumer [**Antoine Lie**][83] for *Scent and Subversion*, Barbara asked
him to help her create a collection of fragrances as bold as her favorite vintage perfumes but for a
modern audience.

Named after ERIS, the Greek goddess of troublemaking and disruption, ERIS PARFUMS is inspired by
muses — divine, human, and fragrant — that exemplify unconventional beauty and subversive glamour.

## What You Can Do With Foley 

[Foley - Feature - CSA Monitor]
CSA Monitoring 
Stay on top of your fleet’s safety. Foley’s CSA Monitor alerts you to crashes,  inspections, and
violations for every driver, so you can spot risks early and stay audit-ready year-round.  
[ Learn More ][88]
[Foley-Feature - Hiring & Onboarding]
Foley Hiring, Screening & Onboarding 
Hire in days, not weeks. From job ad to background check to employee file, Foley gives you
everything you need to move fast and stay compliant.
[ Learn More ][89]
[Foley-Feature - Apply By Licence]
Foley Hiring, Screening & Onboarding 
With just a license photo, applicants can kick off the process—letting you instantly pre-screen and
identify qualified drivers in minutes, not hours. 
[ Learn More ][90]
[Navigator Guidence - Home Page]
 **Navigator AI guidance ** 
 Foley surfaces the signals—Navigator explains what they mean. Get quick clarity on compliance
questions, recommended actions, and what to document next, without waiting on training or support.

Proven Track Record with Our Customers

## Solutions

Background Checks Drug & Alcohol Testing FMCSA Clearinghouse DOT Driver Files MVR Monitor Audit Risk
Monitor
[Foley - Feature - Background Checks]
Background Checks
Whether you’re backfilling a CDL driver or growing your office team, Foley helps you run the
background checks that matter. From criminal and education history to social media and specialty
screens, we make it easy to hire with confidence—no matter the role.  
[ Learn More ][92]
[Foley - Feature - Drug & Alcohol Testing]
Drug & Alcohol Testing
Fast, reliable drug and alcohol testing that keeps you compliant. Foley makes it easy to schedule
pre-employment, random, post-accident, return-to-duty, and reasonable suspicion tests at over 12,000
collection sites nationwide. 
[ Learn More ][93]
[Foley - Feature - Clearing House]
FMCSA Clearinghouse
Foley acts as your Third-Party Administrator (TPA) to take care of your Clearinghouse requirements.
We’ll register your company, manage driver consent, run required queries, and file records on your
behalf so you can stay focused on hiring. 
[ Learn More ][94]
[Foley - Feature - Driver Files]
DOT Driver Files
Whether you’re starting from paper files or building a program from scratch, Foley helps you create
and maintain digital driver qualification files that meet FMCSA requirements. We make it simple to
stay compliant and organized as your team grows. 
[ Learn More ][95]
[Folley - Feature - Motor Vehicle Records]
MVR Monitoring 
Don’t wait a year to find out there’s a problem. Foley’s MVR Monitor alerts you when a driver gets a
new violation, license suspension, or other reportable event so you can respond quickly and reduce
risk across your fleet
[ Learn More ][96]
[Folley - Feature - Audit Risk]
Audit Risk Monitor
Stay one step ahead of compliance issues. Foley’s Audit Risk Monitor keeps an eye on your safety
data and flags changes that could increase your chances of an FMCSA review. You’ll know where to
focus before small issues turn into big problems. 
[ Learn More ][97]


[Foley-Story-Consolidated Transportation Compliance Service]
One Partner for Countless Initiatives
Every company has different goals. Whether you're going paperless, tightening up compliance,
reducing risk, or preparing to grow, Foley helps you get there faster with tools that fit your
workflow and support that fits your team. 
[ Learn More ][98]


[Foley-Feature - All Sizes]
Serving Growing Companies of All Sizes
Foley supports companies of all sizes—from new entrants just getting started to nationwide fleets
with thousands of employees. Wherever you are in your journey, we’re built to help you stay
compliant and keep growing. 
[ Learn More ][99]

medical devices.

the UK, Europe & Rest of World.

High Quality Medical Devices

competitive price.

About Us

Found in 2009,Wuxi NEST Biotechnology is a worldwide manufacturer of plastic laboratory products.
State-of-the-art manufacturing equipment is used on an expansive manufacturing site based in Wuxi,
China. Decades of plastic-injection molding experience allows us to maintain the highest quality and
performance standards expected by the hospitals, research institutions and indusrial/clinical
laboraories that we serve, NEST is your best choice for laboratory consumables. NEST has launched
over 200 plastic consumable products for cell culture, molecular bislogy, immunoassays, liquid
handling and storage. With stricty controlled ISO 8 grade clean rooms, exacting manufacturing
standards and rigid QA procedures, the NEST brand enjoys an excellent reputation nationwide and
abroad. NEST products have been exported to North America, Europe, Japan, Korea, India and other
countries. NEST is committed to innovation. We continue to research and develop new platic
consumables suitable for life sciences research so that we can provide more cost-effective solutions
and cutting-edge laboratory consumables for our end-users. NEST has continually positioned itself as
a brand for high end laboratory consumables. NEST boasts of a high power laminar flow clean room
meeting the ISO 8 grade with a floor space of 2,000 square meters. These facilities are equipped
with a central feeding system, high precision injection machinery from Japan, robot arms with
automatic conveyers, hot runner molds, and vacuum plasma and corona treatment machines from Belgium,
Germany and USA. Inner room moisture content and temperature are adjustable. In 2013, NEST installed
a Rhodotron TT 200 from Belgium IBA, a world leader in the E-Beam sterilization industry. NEST
completes a full process chain from the sourcing of the raw materials to the in-house sterilization
of the final products ready for delivery to clients. NEST`s manufacturing site has been certified
with an ISO 9001:2008 management system. Our sterilization procedures meet the ISO 11137:2006 and
ISO 13485 standards.

About Us

Found in 2009,Wuxi NEST Biotechnology is a worldwide manufacturer of plastic laboratory products.
State-of-the-art manufacturing equipment is used on an expansive manufacturing site based in Wuxi,
China. Decades of plastic-injection molding experience allows us to maintain the highest quality and
performance standards expected by the hospitals, research institutions and indusrial/clinical
laboraories that we serve, NEST is your best choice for laboratory consumables. NEST has launched
over 200 plastic consumable products for cell culture, molecular bislogy, immunoassays, liquid
handling and storage. With stricty controlled ISO 8 grade clean rooms, exacting manufacturing
standards and rigid QA procedures, the NEST brand enjoys an excellent reputation nationwide and
abroad. NEST products have been exported to North America, Europe, Japan, Korea, India and other
countries. NEST is committed to innovation. We continue to research and develop new platic
consumables suitable for life sciences research so that we can provide more cost-effective solutions
and cutting-edge laboratory consumables for our end-users. NEST has continually positioned itself as
a brand for high end laboratory consumables. NEST boasts of a high power laminar flow clean room
meeting the ISO 8 grade with a floor space of 2,000 square meters. These facilities are equipped
with a central feeding system, high precision injection machinery from Japan, robot arms with
automatic conveyers, hot runner molds, and vacuum plasma and corona treatment machines from Belgium,
Germany and USA. Inner room moisture content and temperature are adjustable. In 2013, NEST installed
a Rhodotron TT 200 from Belgium IBA, a world leader in the E-Beam sterilization industry. NEST
completes a full process chain from the sourcing of the raw materials to the in-house sterilization
of the final products ready for delivery to clients. NEST`s manufacturing site has been certified
with an ISO 9001:2008 management system. Our sterilization procedures meet the ISO 11137:2006 and
ISO 13485 standards.

## Our Story

### [Evolving with DJs since 1994]

For over 30 years, we've driven the evolution of DJ technology to expand creativity for artists
worldwide. Today, AlphaTheta draws on the DNA of Pioneer and Pioneer DJ, continuing our legacy of
innovation and engineering excellence.

In 1994, Pioneer launched the CDJ-500 – the world's first flat-top CD player with a turntable feel.
Combining digital precision with analog touch, it revolutionized DJing and marked the start of our
DJ business.

[1994][CDJ-500][145]

### [Defining the global club standard: CDJ & DJM series]

The CDJ and DJM series have defined the global club standard of DJ equipment for decades.In 2006,
the CDJ-1000MK3 achieved intuitive CD scratching through its exceptional jog wheel control, while
the DJM-800 introduced high-quality digital sound processing and more creative effects.Together,
they became the go-to setup for clubs around the world – shaping the experience of modern dance
music.

[CDJ-1000MK3][146]
[2006][DJM-800][147]

### [Expanding creative choices: DDJ & XDJ series]

As DJ culture evolved, so did we.In 2012, the DDJ-SX changed the game for controller DJs – combining
PC power and Serato software for a professional experience. In 2015, the XDJ-RX delivered
club-quality performance as a compact all-in-one device capable of playing tracks managed in
rekordbox directly from a USB drive.Both series continue to evolve – empowering DJs with new ways to
perform and express their creativity.

[2012][DDJ-SX][148]
[2015][XDJ-RX][149]

### [The next chapter: AlphaTheta]

In 2024, we launched our brand, AlphaTheta, to drive innovation.The rotary mixer, euphonia, delivers
an immersive sound that combines warmth and clarity, while the next-generation DJ player, the
CDJ-3000X, opens new horizons for professionals.From Pioneer to Pioneer DJ, and now to AlphaTheta,
our DNA of innovation and quality lives on.

[2024][euphonia][150]
[2025][CDJ-3000X][151]

###### ORAL FLUID COLLECTION, OPTIMISED FOR WHOLE SALIVA, DNA, RNA, PROTEINS AND MORE

## Precision Saliva Sampling for Better Health Research

Salvivo transforms how saliva samples are collected and processed, making health monitoring more
accessible and patient-friendly. Our standardized collection systems enable researchers to gather
high-quality samples efficiently without compromising accuracy.

Saliva offers unique advantages for detecting biomarkers linked to both oral and systemic diseases.
As the biological fluid of choice for clinical research, it provides an easy, non-invasive solution
for health monitoring and disease prevention across diverse populations.

Our precision tools deliver convenient, rapid sampling that supports health maintenance and overall
wellbeing. With high patient acceptance and no need for needles or blood draws, Salvivo's solutions
fit seamlessly into existing research workflows.

**Key Benefits:**
* **Standardised collection** - Eliminate pre-analytical variables and processing complexity.
* **Flexible locations** - Enable sample collection in a variety of settings.
* **Patient-friendly** - Non-invasive alternative to blood sampling with high acceptance.
* **Versatile applications** - Support both oral and general health research.
* **Workflow integration** - Process samples using existing laboratory protocols.

# We value helping researchers.

### Supporting research and innovation.

[ About ][44]
 

We are part of the Center of Excellence (COE) program at Salimetrics. We have as our primary goal to
promote credible scientific findings through better saliva testing. We have been developing and
delivering innovative, customised solutions to help scientists experiencing the cutting-edge of
scientific progress in salivary bioscience.


[lab 2.jpg]

### Better compliance, better results

We provide saliva collection methods from SalivaBio, which have been designed to increase
participant compliance and maximize sample integrity. Salimetrics and SalivaBio work with
researchers to advance collection systems and devices that have become the trusted methods for
researchers driven by scientific credibility.

[Learn More][45]
 
[Lab 3.JPG]

### Better salivary bioscience integration

Seeking information regarding integrating saliva into your research, or training on using saliva
collection methods with the highest level of rigor and reproducibility for your salivary bioscience
research? Salivary Bioscience Workshops can be scheduled at your location and we will provide a
workshop focused on integrating salivary bioscience into research. 

[Learn More][46]
 
[Saliva dog.jpg]

### Novel biomarkers

Saliva sampling is a simple and reliable method. It is a great alternative to blood collection,
particularly for those patients who are anxious about having blood collected. Start your testing off
right by choosing an assay that is optimized for the sample matrix in which you are testing.

[Learn More][47]

### “Salivary bioscience is ready to translate its findings in an even bigger way.”

— Douglas Granger, Ph.D., Salimetrics Founder and Chief Scientific and Strategy Advisor

## Resources for Clean Competition

## Inspired by Our Athletes and Partners
## What We Do

USADA is committed to protecting the integrity of sport and ensuring a level playing field for clean
athletes. We stand with athletes and for athletes, making sure that their rights are guiding our
every decision and every action. Our unparalleled anti-doping services and programs are also rooted
in the latest anti-doping science and decades of expertise so that athletes receive the excellence
they deserve from our education, testing, and results management operations. We work alongside a
diverse range of organizations and individuals in this shared effort to ensure that athletes can
compete clean and win. From athletes to coaches to medical professionals, USADA has tailored
resources and services to support the clean sport journey.

Education Science Testing Results Management

## Education

Through in-person and online education, as well as a multitude of other resources, USADA helps
ensure that athletes and support personnel have the tools they need to navigate anti-doping rules
and responsibilities, while also understanding the role they play in keeping sport clean.

We continually update and expand our library of resources to ensure that athletes and athlete
support personnel can easily access the most up-to-date information on the most important topics in
anti-doping.

[ Learn More ][182]

Director, Tammy Hanson, talking to athletes at a presentation.]

## Science

Science plays a crucial role in the fight for clean competition by driving innovation and
evidence-based decision making. At USADA, science and research inform education strategies, testing,
and results management operations, while also enhancing detection and deterrence efforts. USADA is
also a global leader in anti-doping science, partnering with stakeholders around the world to drive
advancements.

[ Learn More ][183]

putting liquids in beakers]

## Testing

Testing is an integral part of USADA’s ability to detect doping and hold accountable those who
violate anti-doping rules. Both in-competition and no advance notice, out-of-competition testing are
part of an effective anti-doping program that protects clean athletes’ rights and a level playing
field.

USADA testing is strategic to maximize detection and deterrence and best utilize our resources. It
is also guided by detailed policies and procedures to protect the integrity of the process and make
the process as consistent and comfortable as possible for athletes.

[ Learn More ][184]
[SafeSystem by InnoVero sample collection equipment.][SafeSystem by InnoVero sample collection
equipment.]

## Results Management

USADA communicates with athletes regarding test results and manages any potential anti-doping rule
violations. This independent results management process removes the inherent conflict of interest
associated with sport organizations trying to both promote and police their sports. USADA’s policies
and procedures afford a full and fair legal process to athletes and support personnel at all times.

About Villagers & Heroes
[ [Vh showcase 3] ][147]

[Villagers and Heroes][148] is a free-to-play MMO game in which players experience not just the
thrill of battling unique monsters or the satisfaction of tailoring an exquisite robe, but the
pleasure of building lasting friendships within a friendly community.

Join hundreds of thousands of players worldwide in an epic MMO in a massive 3D world filled with
swords, sorcery, dungeons, dragons, wizards, warriors, quests galore, countless beasties, and people
from all over the globe.

Villagers and Heroes is currently available on [PC][149], [Android][150], and [iOS][151]!

Wren Laboratories has received Emergency Use Authorization from the U.S. Food and Drug
Administration for its saliva-based PCR laboratory diagnostic test to determine infection from

###### Highly Sensitive

Yields results and accuracy (>99%) as good as the FDA's gold-standard nasopharyngeal PCR swabbing
tests.

###### Saliva-based Testing

Easier to use and less invasive than nasopharyngeal swabbing and does not need the guidance or
assistance of medical personnel.

###### Flexible Testing

Patients can provide a saliva sample themselves at home, at work or anywhere else without the need
to go to a test center or other medical facility.

###### Flexible Delivery

Samples can be sent to Wren Laboratories by UPS, FedEx or any other delivery service with no special
transport requirements.

###### Fast Results

Patients will normally receive their results within 48 hours of the sample being received by the
laboratory.

###### Long Shelf Life

The test kit has a shelf life of 12 months ensuring that tests can be used when needed without
having to worry about expiry dates.
